chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 224: The Retired Soldier’s Blood Robe – Ji Ning’s Secret Is Exposed
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning uncovers Crippled Moon Realperson’s secret army background and scrambles to erase evidence, but Beishan Blacktiger deduces the truth. Can he survive the Northmont clan’s wrath?
og_title: Desolate Era – Chapter 224: The Retired Soldier’s Blood Robe
og_description: Ji Ning discovers Crippled Moon Realperson was a retired soldier of the Northmont clan’s secret Xuan Army. His careful clean-up may not be enough.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 224: Blood Robe Secrets
twitter_description: Ji Ning kills a secret army veteran—and the Northmont clan is already hunting him.

lore_anchors.definition: A uniform inscribed with runic patterns that allow multiple wearers to link their power into a single joint formation, similar to Dao-soldier armor.
A minor world, possibly created by a mighty figure, where the Northmont clan’s secret Xuan Army campaigns and fights.
The secret military force of the Anchan Northmont clan, composed of long-serving cultivators who often retire after millennia of campaigning.
A primal force deep within a planet’s core, visible as a divine glow, that can destroy spiritual imprints and is used here to dispose of traceable treasures.
The marquis of Anchan and father of Beishan Baiwei; a powerful and perceptive cultivator who deduces Ji Ning’s involvement.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning throw away the jade bottle?
cultural_notes_faq.a: To avoid leaving any hidden imprint or tracking fluid that could be used to trace the Primordial Liquid back to him.
A secret army of the Northmont clan, composed of cultivators who campaign in foreign minor worlds like Tianfang World for millennia before retiring.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Beishan Blacktiger figure out Ji Ning was the killer?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He connected the dots from Baiwei’s request for intelligence on Yu Tong, Shui Yi, and Dong Qi—the same names that turned up dead.
